nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances; written in the constructor and in _transfer.
Nested mapping of spender allowances; mutated by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total supply 10*10**9*10**18 assigned at construction.
Owner address of the Ownable contract; read by owner() and written by renounce/transfer.
Address captured as _msgSender() at deployment; the real value checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Context._msgSender() returns msg.sender; the only path for caller identity.
Modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender(); permanent deployer-only gate, not tied to _owner.
Returns _owner state variable.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0) but leaves newComer unchanged.
private onlyOwner function writing _owner to newOwner; unreachable externally (private).
Mints the whole _tTotal to _msgSender() at deployment.
Private approval writer; silently forces allowance to 0 and emits Approval(...,4) whenever the owner argument differs from owner().
Public ERC20 approve that forwards _msgSender() and amount into _approve.
Public ERC20 transfer that moves _msgSender() balance to recipient via _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer then rewrites the allowance through _approve.
Internal balance movement using SafeMath sub/add; no external calls and no reentrancy guard needed.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View returning _tTotal.
View returning _balances[account].
Library helper that forwards ETH through a low-level call after a balance require.
Library helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and bubbling reverts via assembly.
extcodehash-based contract existence check used as a pre-condition before low-level calls.
Caller-controlled address reaching _msgSender, onlyOwner, the constructor mint, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") - external value transfer to an attacker-supplied address without a reentrancy guard.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) - arbitrary external call with attacker-controlled target and calldata.
amount argument of _transfer used in the SafeMath sub/add balance updates.
sender argument of _transfer; indexed into _balances.
recipient argument of _transfer; credited in _balances.
Owner-side argument of _approve compared against owner().
Spender-side argument of _approve used to index _allowances.
Requested allowance in _approve; discarded when ol != owner().
Recipient argument of the public transfer function.
Amount argument of the public transfer function.
Debited account supplied by the caller of transferFrom.
Credited account supplied by the caller of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transferFrom, used for the SafeMath subtraction on _allowances.
New owner address written into the _owner state variable.
Payable recipient passed as the low-level call target in sendValue.
Value forwarded to the untrusted recipient in sendValue.
Call target of _functionCallWithValue, fully caller-controlled.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to target in _functionCallWithValue.
ETH value forwarded to target in _functionCallWithValue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender().
onlyOwner compares the _msgSender() result against newComer.
newComer, fixed at deployment, is the value the onlyOwner modifier checks instead of _owner.
onlyOwner gate governs renounceOwnership execution.
onlyOwner gate governs transferOwnership execution.
Constructor mints _tTotal to _msgSender().
_tTotal is read in the constructor to seed the deployer balance.
Constructor writes _balances[_msgSender()] = _tTotal.
approve passes _msgSender() as the owner argument of _approve.
approve unconditionally calls _approve.
_approve silently zeroes _allowances[ol][tt] whenever ol is not the owner.
owner() is compared against ol inside _approve to pick the write branch.
owner() exposes the _owner state variable.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debit side of _transfer.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance bookkeeping.
transferFrom first calls _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance by calling _approve.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is read and decremented in transferFrom without regard to the owner check inside _approve.
sender parameter indexes the debited balance inside _transfer.
recipient parameter indexes the credited balance inside _transfer.
amount parameter feeds the SafeMath sub/add operations on balances.
sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}("") which hands control to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value: weiValue}(data), an arbitrary external callback.
The call target of the value transfer is the caller-supplied recipient parameter.
The ETH amount forwarded to the untrusted recipient comes from the amount parameter.
The low-level call destination is the attacker-controlled target parameter.
Arbitrary calldata from the data parameter is forwarded to the external target.
weiValue parameter is forwarded as msg.value of the external call.
isContract is required before _functionCallWithValue performs the low-level call.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
newOwner parameter is validated and stored as the new _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
ol parameter determines whether the allowance is written or force-zeroed.
tt parameter indexes the spender slot in _allowances.
amount parameter is silently discarded (allowance set to 0) when ol != owner().
recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded from transfer into the SafeMath balance math.
sender parameter is debited and used as the allowance owner key in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance with SafeMath.sub in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a parameter of _transfer and only exists to feed its balance arithmetic.
sender is a parameter of _transfer and only indexes the debited balance.
recipient is a parameter of _transfer and only indexes the credited balance.
ol is a parameter of _approve and is only used for the owner comparison branch.
tt is a parameter of _approve and only indexes the _allowances mapping.
amount is a parameter of _approve that may be discarded; it belongs to _approve.
recipient is a parameter of transfer forwarded directly into _transfer.
amount is a parameter of transfer forwarded directly into the balance math.
sender is a parameter of transferFrom used for debit and allowance key.
recipient is a parameter of transferFrom forwarded into _transfer.
amount is a parameter of transferFrom used in the allowance subtraction.
newOwner is a parameter of transferOwnership and is stored as the owner.
recipient is a parameter of sendValue and becomes the unsafe call target.
amount is a parameter of sendValue and becomes the value of the unsafe call.
target is a parameter of _functionCallWithValue and becomes the unsafe call destination.
data is a parameter of _functionCallWithValue and becomes the unsafe call calldata.
weiValue is a parameter of _functionCallWithValue and becomes the unsafe call value.
